params.body:
GLK's worksheets app (`trendwolves/glk-transferor`) becomes a running system the workbench may read: `glk:transferor`, with one kind, `glk.read`, on the 30-day read word.

- `Capability::SYSTEMS`: B1 only. There is no action, so `layerKinds($glk, 'B2')` is empty and the project page shows no repair block.
- `SYSTEM_INFO` and the labels in `Capability` and `Grants`: what the owner admits, in one sentence. The app's health, its Bouwsoft connection, its sites with a dry run of the sync, and its worksheets counted; never a worker's name, audio or a token.

The app checks the mandate and the agent's signature itself (glk-transferor, `App\Control\ReadMandate`). Control and Elixir do not change: they only know B2 kinds.

Test: `ReadLayerTest::test_the_glk_app_is_read_only_on_its_own_project`. Full suite 742/743; the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which fails in any worktree.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01EWy1829KawX3VL5LnrkdXD
params.title: GLK's worksheets app as a running system the workbench may read (glk.read)
